credits.title: Louise
credits.overview: Follows the struggles of Marion in her attempt to reconnect with her family and piece together her fragmented identity after fleeing a troubled childhood.

credits.title: Under Paris
credits.overview: In order to save Paris from an international bloodbath, a grieving scientist is forced to face her tragic past when a giant shark appears in the Seine.

credits.title: Even Lovers Get the Blues
credits.overview: After the sudden death of one of them a group of friends grieves trough sexual encounters.

credits.title: The Brand New Testament
credits.overview: God lives in Brussels. On Earth though, God is a coward, morally pathetic and odious to his family. His daughter, Ea, is bored at home and can't stand being locked up in a small apartment in ordinary Brussels, until the day she decides to revolt against her dad...

credits.title: Serial Teachers 2
credits.overview: The worst teachers of France landed in England for an ultra-secret mission. With Boulard, the King of the Dunces, they are parachuted in the best school of the country, and they will apply their famous methods on the future of the nation.
